description: Erection of a single storey rear infill and rear extension and addition of a first floor side window to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01; 02; 03; 04; 05; 06  Received:  21 April 2023;  Unreferenced Proposed Block Plan; Unreferenced Location Plan  Received:  13 February 2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill and rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the proposed drawings hereby approved, the approved additional first floor side window within the house's two storey rear outrigger shall be obscure glazed and non-openable below 1.75 metres above finished floor level and be permanently retained as such.
